purpose: Base vs guest money-path ticker tiers and RTH observability minimums.

guest_ticker_policy.definition: Any symbol not in base_money_path_tickers unless explicitly promoted by coverage proof.

promoted_guest_policy.definition: Operator-selected symbol that passes the same observability checker as a base ticker for a recent session window.
promoted_guest_policy.promotion_requires: check_base_ticker_observability PASS_BASE_OBSERVABILITY for named date range

rth_observability_thresholds.calibration_log_parity_note: When ED_CALIBRATION_LOG=1, calibration_decision_log rows should track full-pipeline fetches; may exceed snapshot count when throttle skips duplicate-minute inserts but calibration still logs.

evidence_classification_note: Universal money-path readiness requires PASS_BASE_OBSERVABILITY for every base ticker on the audit date. SPY-only proof does not generalize.

sparsity_investigation_2026_06_16.summary: Chronic snapshot row inequality — not a June-16-only query artifact.
sparsity_investigation_2026_06_16.cal_log_parity: calibration_decision_log row counts match snapshot counts for QQQ/IWM (19=19) — logging is faithful to sparse full-pipeline fetches.
sparsity_investigation_2026_06_16.documented_code_expectation: server.py BACKGROUND MULTI-TICKER LOGGER comments note row-count inequality is expected when UI-heavy symbol (often SPY) drives Tier C fetches at ~1/min while others lag.
likely_mechanisms: Full snapshot INSERT only on successful _fetch_state (quote+chain+signals); active SSE viewer on SPY drives ~1 insert/minute via ED_DB_SNAPSHOT_THROTTLE.

QQQ/IWM observed ~20min median gap — far below design logger cadence (~30s cycle) — indicates sustained full-pipeline persistence did not run at logger design rate for non-active base tickers on this deployment.
Lifetime DB pattern (June 2026): SPY ~380 rows/day avg vs QQQ ~90 vs IWM ~68 — systemic under-capture of base non-primary tickers.
sparsity_investigation_2026_06_16.next_fix_direction: Ensure background logger + base-ticker Tier C warm sustain full _fetch_state snapshot INSERT at SPY-parity cadence for all BASE_MONEY_PATH_TICKERS — file: server.py _logger_loop / _fetch_state / UI_MAXIMIZE panel warm.
